## Four-game projection (upper bounds from extraction)

| game | unique MSX tiles | 2bpp upper bound | sprite bytes | note |

| nemesis | 1169 | 18704 | 98304 | measured: current ROM holds all 12 descriptors and CHR for Nemesis |

| salamander | 1534 | 24544 |  | from extractor report |
| nemesis3 | 6361 | 101776 |  | from extractor report |

CHR upper bound for all four games: 360 KiB before deduplication.

Upper bound counts every unique MSX tile as one 2bpp NES tile and every sprite set uncompressed; global deduplication (reports/global_dedup.json) and palette merging reduce it. Code, music, cutscenes and tables are not in this bound.

- CHR-ROM (current) vs CHR-RAM with compressed CHR in PRG: CHR-RAM frees PRG banks for graphics and allows compression; CHR-ROM keeps zero-cost bank switching.
- PRG must grow beyond 128 KiB for chapters 2-4; 512 KiB PRG is the working assumption, 1 MiB the ceiling.
